reason: Eight handler-level defects from the api.py audit. (1) The resource resolve map, the relation endpoint map and migration 0011 named the entity kind 'browser_traffic_exchanges', which no entity declares (BrowserTrafficExchange.entity_kind is 'browser_traffic'), so every HTTP exchange resolved as inaccessible, every action on one was disabled as 'no longer exists' and evidence->produced_by->exchange relations were refused 404; api.py now shares relations.RESOURCE_ENTITY_KINDS, which is checked against ENTITY_MODEL_BY_KIND at import. (2) hmac.compare_digest raises TypeError on non-ASCII str, and Starlette decodes headers as latin-1, so a stray byte in Authorization/Origin/CSRF turned 401/403 into an unhandled 500 and crashed every websocket negotiator before accept; one byte-safe _secret_matches helper now serves the HTTP dependencies, the pairing redeem and all websocket negotiators. (3) The harness /chat/completions raised the 'one browser session' 409 after prepare_chat had persisted the user message and a pending turn nobody starts; the check now runs first. (7) The harness-turn and browser-assessment event sockets caught only disconnects, so a deleted assessment or a runtime failure tore the socket down with no frame; they now mirror the execution socket (NotFoundError -> complete + 4404, Exception -> error frame). (8) /health and /diagnostics/files echoed the absolute log directory and settings path to cookie-paired devices; DiagnosticManager.status() no longer includes them. (9) The device heartbeat stored the client's clock as heartbeat_at/last_used_at so clock skew broke liveness; the broker stamps utc_now() and keeps the client value as metadata.client_heartbeat_at. (13) Pairing redeem popped the offer before checking the confirmation code, so one typo burned the QR and blamed the secret; the code is verified first with a bounded attempt counter and a distinct detail. (14) DiagnosticsError was unmapped so an unwritable settings file was a generic 500; it is now a retryable 503. Proof: test_relations.py::test_browser_exchange_is_a_resolvable_relation_endpoint, test_action_broker.py::test_actions_resolve_for_an_existing_browser_exchange and ::test_heartbeat_stamps_server_time_and_keeps_the_client_clock_as_metadata, and in test_api.py test_resolve_resource_finds_an_existing_browser_exchange, test_non_ascii_credentials_are_rejected_instead_of_crashing, test_harness_chat_rejects_two_browser_companions_before_persisting, test_harness_turn_event_socket_sends_an_error_frame_on_stream_failure, test_browser_assessment_event_socket_completes_when_the_assessment_is_deleted, test_health_does_not_expose_host_paths, test_pairing_redeem_reports_a_wrong_code_and_lets_the_phone_retry and test_diagnostics_settings_write_failure_is_a_retryable_503; each fails on main. test_diagnostics_api.py, test_diagnostics.py and test_chat_api.py guard the status() payload, the CLI status output and the existing pairing flow.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through src/nebula/v3/api.py) does not exercise resource resolution, non-ASCII credentials, harness companion attachment, the harness/assessment event sockets, the health payload, device heartbeats, pairing redeem retries or diagnostics settings write failures; the Python tests drive them directly. No full suites.
